newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - White Martins still a hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - White Martins still a hold.

text.p: Fator Securities said it has reiterated its hold recommendation and set a 12-month target price of 3.50 reais on shares of industrial and medical gases firm White Martins.
-- Fator analyst Juan Tseng said in a report the stock is well priced now but would be a good value if it dropped below 2.70 reais.
-- Common shares of White Martins were off 0.32 percent at 3.09 reais at 1230 local/1130 edt/1530 GMT in Sao Paulo.
-- White Martins' merger in April 1996 with Liquid Carbonic "has positioned the firm to benefit from industrial growth in all South America," Tseng wrote.
-- He also said orders continue to grow and would allow for a cash flow growth of 17 percent in the next three years.
-- He added that the company's policy on free cash flow is to distribute it to shareholders.
-- White Martins is South America's leader in industrial gases and represents U.S.-based Praxair Inc's operations in the region, Tseng said.
